The '''Pearl''' is a special item that can be obtained in a number of ways.

==Locations==
Pearls can be found in:
*7% chance from [[Fishing#Golden Treasure Chests|Golden Fishing Treasure Chests]].<ref name="chestchance" />
*0.4% chance while fishing in the [[Night Market#Fishing Submarine|submarine ride]] at the [[Night Market]] [[Festivals|Festival]] (0.9% if using a [[Curiosity Lure]]).
*1.7-1.9% chance from a [[Blobfish]] [[Fish Pond]] with a population of at least 9. 
*0.49% Chance from opening a [[Mystery Box]].
*0.94% Chance from opening a [[Golden Mystery Box]].
*3.6% chance from an [[Artifact Trove]].
*Received as a guaranteed gold tier reward on the 12th of Winter for the [[SquidFest]] festival.
*One after solving [[Journal Scraps#Journal Scrap #6|Journal Scrap #6]] on [[Ginger Island]].
*One from [[Willy]] after filling a Fish Pond with 10 [[Crab]]s and talking to him within 14 days. 
*Foraging in [[The Mines]] after activating the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Shrine of Challenge]] or during the [[Quests#Danger In The Deep|Danger In The Deep]] quest.
*One by clicking on the clam shells in the correct sequence in the Mermaid Boat at the Night Market.  The correct sequence is listed in [[Secret Notes#Secret Note #15|Secret Note #15]]. Only one Pearl can be obtained from the Mermaid Boat per [[Saves|save file]], or one per player in [[Multiplayer]]. 
{{Collapse|Correct Sequence|content=From left to right: 1-5-4-2-3}}

==Uses==
Pearls can be [[Tailoring|tailored]], [[Friendship#Gifts|gifted]] as a universally loved gift, sold for {{Price|2500}}, or placed into [[Fish Tank]]s. The [[Desert Trader]] in the [[The Desert|Calico Desert]] sells one [[Birch Double Bed]] for one Pearl.

==Bundles==
The Pearl is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
The Pearl is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Bridal Veil|class=inline}}.

==Quests==
The Pearl is not used in any [[quests]].
